answer: Treat the agent network as a trust graph where each vertex must post a refundable stake to transact. A fake identity cannot cheaply spawn thousands of peers, because every new vertex demands real collateral, and honest counterparties only extend credit after repeated settled exchanges. Reputation then propagates like a ripple outward from proven nodes, so sybils stranded in an unvouched meadow earn no edges, no credit, and no influence over consensus.
